name: Canglan Lian Shi: Daijin de Bayue zhi Xing
original_name: 苍蓝恋诗：殆尽的八月之星
source: Welcome to Tenkei City, the last miracle city of humanity on this planet. On the eve of the quadrennial Tenkei Festival, you return upon the commission of Lunar Corporation, Forge bonds, encounter love, or perhaps...break the facade of 'Eternity'.
translation: Welcome to Tenkei City, the last miracle city of humanity on this planet. On the eve of the quadrennial Tenkei Festival, you return upon the commission of Lunar Corporation, Forge bonds, encounter love, or perhaps...break the facade of 'Eternity'.
